label: THE RESEARCH WORKSPACE
title:
A question.
A measurable
experiment.
body: ARIA Researcher brings wildfire experiments, error analysis, and the next research decision into one workspace.
note: A guided tour of the working app

label: 01 / COMPARE RUNS
title:
See what
actually
changed.
body: In this study, validation average precision rose from 0.1842 to 0.4861. Compare the measured result with the configuration that produced it.
note: Recorded results from the newly completed training runs

label: 02 / INVESTIGATE A WEAK SPOT
title:
Go beyond
one score.
body: California missed fires fell from 18 to 14, while false alarms rose from 10 to 17. The proposed subgroup goal was not met.
note: At each run’s own threshold · Improvement comes with a tradeoff

label: 03 / ASK ARIA
title:
Ask about
these runs.
body: ARIA receives the selected experiment evidence. Its answer links the explanation to the recorded runs and cited measurements.
note: Saved, verified ARIA answer from an earlier study

label: 04 / REVIEW THE NEXT STEP
title:
Turn an error
into a test.
body: Review a proposed hypothesis, configuration, expected benefit, and tradeoffs. Then start the bounded study from its reviewed draft.
note: A testable proposal, with a budget to review

label: 05 / PLAN BEFORE RUNNING
title:
Agree on
the study
before it runs.
body: Ask ARIA for a baseline, experiment sequence, success criteria, and budget. Review the plan before starting the work.
note: Make the research objective and its limits explicit

label: 06 / CHECK THE IMPROVEMENT
title:
Test whether
the gain
holds up.
body: Both paired seeds improved over baseline. Mean AP gain: 0.2936. Review the spread before deciding what to test next.
note: Two paired seeds describe training variation, not a confidence interval.

label: 07 / CARRY FINDINGS FORWARD
title:
Research
that builds
on itself.
body: Retrieve earlier findings before asking for another experiment. Choose which findings inform the next ARIA request.
note: Keep useful evidence available across sessions

label: 08 / SHARE THE EVIDENCE
title:
Finish with
a research
report.
body: Bring configurations, measured results, verification, and limitations into a reviewable report. Export the evidence for a clear handoff.

label: ARIA RESEARCHER
title:
From an
observed error
to a testable
next step.
body:
Compare. Investigate. Propose. Verify.

Keep the reasoning and the evidence together.
note: Validation-only research prototype · Not an operational wildfire warning system
